query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN chebi_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_chebi,
  SUM(CASE WHEN family IS NOT NULL AND family != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_family,
  SUM(CASE WHEN chebi_id IS NOT NULL AND (family IS NULL OR family = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as chebi_no_family,
  SUM(CASE WHEN chemical_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_class
FROM molecules;
